answer: A bond is refunded only after 32 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The kernel counter is kept in thread and vertex shows each reset. An adversary hence has to keep every alias continuously active for 32 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3408 identities would post 3949 proofs and burn roughly 73 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
